done

command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
media_before=$(sha256sum chain.txt $(sed -n '/./p' chain.txt))
stage=$(mktemp -d /srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain/.recovered-stage.XXXXXX)
cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$stage"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
while IFS= read -r archive; do
  [ -n "$archive" ] || continue
  [ -f "$archive" ] || { printf 'missing archive: %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1; }
  case "$archive" in /*|*..*) printf 'unsafe archive name: %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  tar --exclude=deletions.txt -xf "$archive" -C "$stage"
  if tar -tf "$archive" | grep -qx 'deletions.txt'; then
    tar -xOf "$archive" deletions.txt | while IFS= read -r deleted || [ -n "$deleted" ]; do
      [ -n "$deleted" ] || continue
      case "$deleted" in /*|..|../*|*/../*|*/..) printf 'unsafe deletion: %s\n' "$deleted" >&2; exit 1;; esac
      rm -rf -- "$stage/$deleted"
    done
  fi
done < chain.txt
[ ! -e recovered ] || { printf 'recovered unexpectedly exists\n' >&2; exit 1; }
mv "$stage" recovered
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
media_after=$(sha256sum chain.txt $(sed -n '/./p' chain.txt))
[ "$media_before" = "$media_after" ]
printf 'reconstruction complete; recovery media hashes unchanged\n'
find recovered -xdev -printf '%y %M %u:%g %s %P\n' | sort
